title: Extend one diagonal diagram to one finite coefficient field
statement: Let ell be prime and let Y, P1_Y and its self-product be Noetherian, with ell invertible on Y. For every Z_ell Diagram d in [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category] and every finite subextension E of Qbar_ell/Q_ell, there exist an integral Diagram i over O_E with spIntegralTwist and a rational Diagram r over E with spRationalTwist. Their scalar comparisons in [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-scalars] are ScalarCompatibility for the actual integralMap, integralLineMap and rationalLineMap of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-maps]: d to i and i to r. No transition to another finite field and no closure diagram is asserted.

proof.text: Pull l-invertibility to P and W. Apply the finite integral endpoint theorem at P,W. For rationalization the integral line is locally free of rank one; the signed-line tensor equivalence and internal/section flatness give its flatness. The flat endpoint theorem therefore supplies the rational endpoints directly, since spRationalTwist and rationalLineMap are defined by ordinary scalar extension and its unit.

The three projective-line projections are qcqs. Apply the finite/localization scalar-square theorem with the actual input right-derived models to obtain normalized restriction squares and their invertible scalar mates on the shifted lines.

Apply diagonal_scalar_diagram_of_squares with the integral line endpoints and integral scalar squares, obtaining the integral Diagram and its ScalarCompatibility. Apply it again with the flat rational endpoints and rational scalar squares, obtaining the rational Diagram and its ScalarCompatibility. Pair the witnesses and comparisons.

proof_origin.place: paragraphs (1)--(2); application of the proved generic scalar-diagram transport to the integral and rational comparisons

theorem diagonalCoefficient_finiteExtension
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (d : Diagram (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) Y (zlLine l))
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l) :
    ∃ i : Diagram (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj.{u} l E.1) Y
        (fun X ↦ spIntegralTwist X l E),
      ∃ r : Diagram (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} E.1) Y
          (fun X ↦ spRationalTwist X l E),
        Nonempty (ScalarCompatibility (integralMap l E) Y (zlLine l)
          (fun X ↦ spIntegralTwist X l E) (integralLineMap l E) d i) ∧
        Nonempty (ScalarCompatibility (padicIntegersRingObjToContinuousMapRingObj l E) Y
          (fun X ↦ spIntegralTwist X l E) (fun X ↦ spRationalTwist X l E)
          (rationalLineMap l E) i r)
